reasons: A 2020 Carrera S coupe with 20,000 miles sold for $116,000 on June 22, 2026.
Two more sold this spring for $117,000 (15,000 miles) and $119,000 (10,000 miles).
This car has 31,775 miles, more than any of those three.
Porsche White Plains lists a certified one in the same green, with 32,047 miles and a 24-month warranty, for $119,955.
The price has already come down from $121,470 on October 28.
pushback: They cite the 34,000-mile car that sold for $124,000. Reply: that was a year ago, and three sales since closed at $116,000 to $119,000.
They say it is priced below market. Reply: below other dealers' asking prices, but above what lower-mile cars actually sold for.
They will not move on price. Ask for the fees to come off or a service to be included, and get the out-the-door number in writing.

summary: Sample deal from the Nov 14, 2026 research. Sold prices come from Classic.com's 2020 Carrera S coupe market page.
